1.

Though our path be hard and thorny, And Thou seemest to hide Thyself, Yet we press onward in faith, And thus find a blessed rest.

2.

All power in heaven and on earth Is given Thee, as Thy word teaches; And all things here serve for good To those who love the Lord.

3.

A peace which surpasses knowledge, For around Thy throne, O God, it reigns, Sinks down into our heart, When our desire we have made known to Thee.
